description: Linux kernel module source code for a Button Hotplug driver, handling input events for buttons and generating uevents.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Handles input events, creates button events, and updates state.

methods.name: button_hotplug_connect
methods.description: Handles connection of input devices with relevant button codes.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event data with environment variables.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a variable to the event skb.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map.
